live_validation_meaning: Attempted on the generic renderer dataset exporter and found not applicable: five of the fifteen required fields (density_bars, checkpoint_path/sha256, config_path/sha256) have no honest source in a task-independent producer. The producer refused rather than inventing them. PASS would require a producer that can supply every required field truthfully.
scope: Generic provenance and reproducibility only; no policy, evaluation, training or controller work
schema_design_limitation: Record Envelope v2 is a task-shaped contract: it inherited seed, density_bars and checkpoint identity from the v1 audit of a simulator artifact. A generic producer cannot fill them. A v2.1 that makes the task section optional is a design change and is NOT made here.
